test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Raveena travels 5 km towards South from her house. From there, she goes 7 km towards East, then 4 km towards South, then 7 km towards West and then finally 5 km towards South. How far is Raveena from her house and in which direction?
solution:
Drawing the diagram according to the given information:

1) Raveena travels 5 km towards South from her house.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c899cb3b355081a992ae56f081ef48bdc2fef4b2da1bdd8b30d1e4e9fed7d943.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c1b9e16a0452cb29be1d3bbc7688d17302b762949e66ff2716c898713a25889d.png] 

2) From there, she goes 7 km towards East.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d0aed4d6dfd435f81a5b69dbd3066e30c408b18cd51498d862e9fae01ea5dfd3.png] 

3) Then, 4 km towards South.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fc9998b9b73b4a16c9d9ad5385b0450d4309abf20cc143f3676e9e11c4a7cc5a.png] 

4) Then, 7 km towards West.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f9ca57145e8c7817d0b828bc5bdb6ad37a8fe49f4695a2a7eec48462b8a5ae1.png] 

5) Then finally, 5 km towards South.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f74af41cf9ee774b31a8856c206aafa20409c9729add7aa1fd575fbf2a9ca687.png] 

So, Raveena is now at a point 14 km south from her house.

Hence, the correct answer is** '****14 km, South'**.
